hooks.command: CODE=$(git log --oneline -10 --diff-filter=M -- '*.go' 'go.mod' | wc -l) && DOCS=$(git log --oneline -5 -- 'CLAUDE.md' 'README.md' 'docs/*.md' | wc -l) && if [ "$CODE" -gt 5 ] && [ "$DOCS" -eq 0 ]; then echo '{"additionalContext": "Docs may be stale. Run /update-docs to sync."}'; fi

hooks.prompt: If the tool edited a file matching cmd/rootline/*.go, internal/*/*.go, or go.mod, respond with {"additionalContext": "Tip: Code changes may affect docs. Consider /update-docs when ready."}. For non-Go files, respond with {"ok": true}. Input: $ARGUMENTS
